Regards,
Community Services Agency

DOCUMENT CHECKLIST

INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAM
Policy Bulletin 2024-07
Effective Date: 2024-08-01

The maximum shelter allowance for single adults is increased from $695 to $725 per month.

All active cases should be reviewed and adjusted by 2024-09-30. No retroactive payments will be issued.

Authorized by: Director, Income Support Programs
Issued: 2024-07-20

INTERNAL MEMO
To: Benefits Assessment Team
From: Case Supervisor
Date: 2024-07-20
Re: Updated processing guidelines

Please note that effective immediately, all new applications must include proof of residency dated within the last 90 days.
